children: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia looks unlikely at this time, with Chairman Harvey Jones wanting to find a permanent CEO as quickly as possible, Interactive Investor's Victoria Scholar writes. The role requires someone who can navigate the geopolitical landscape, the limelight and scrutiny, while at the same time being an exceptional leader, engineer and technologist, she says. "Huang's farewell leaves big boots and a leather jacket to fill," Scholar says. Shares are up 3.4% at $160.68 in premarket trading. (ian.walker@wsj.com)
